name: scale_field
title: Scale-space field on the momentum cohort
order_of_work: 1. adapter.py, plus a test that loads one known event and asserts monotone, positive, in-session timestamps.
2. Allan reconciliation against v3. HARD STOP on divergence.
3. One event, both bands, both channels. Chart it and STOP.
5. Only then: matched-null thresholds, then the cohort.

1_adapter.tests: test_scale_field.py (19) + test_adapter.py (16) + test_verification.py (8, independent adversarial suite)

2_reconciliation_gate.criterion: allan_factor() must reproduce v3's committed curve rung for rung. HARD STOP on divergence -- any divergence means the point-process handling differs from v3's and everything after it is uninterpretable.

4_cooper_reads_it.outcome: knee criterion withdrawn; new order issued

r3_recovery_grid.what: inject tau across a log grid at the two measured background rates (2.46/s, 17.8/s) across intensity contrast and duty cycle; report bias and spread of whichever summary statistic is proposed

r4_matched_null.rule: Rate-matched inhomogeneous Poisson realisations simulated from each event's own intensity estimate, with that event's duration and timestamp quantisation. Machinery already specified in prompts/phase_10b.md T3c (200 draws, 2.5/97.5 percentile band, reported as a family over the bandwidth rather than one band) and already implemented in research/phase_10b/pipeline.py. REUSE IT; DO NOT REBUILD IT.
r4_matched_null.note: on the same s_min mask so null and data share a support

break_pyramid_sensitivity.sigma_lo_is_not_the_knob: sigma_lo does NOT move the decimation boundaries; they sit at 4 * scales.min() * 2^k. sigma_lo cancels in s/dt > 4*sigma_lo with dt = scales.min()/sigma_lo.

cooper_step_4_read.knee_criterion: WITHDRAWN. Neither candidate summary statistic recovers a known timescale at the scales this cohort lives at. The bit-exact Allan reproduction stands as a gate on the point-process plumbing, which is what it tests.

cohort.rule: n_eff = 2*sqrt(pi)*s*lambda >= 8  =>  s >= 2.2568/lambda. Derived from the estimator's own effective sample size, not adopted from anywhere.
cohort.inputs: t0_print_count (frozen cohort manifest) + D3 extended-day span (pinned XNYS calendar). No field computation, no tick pass.

vs_subbursts.caveat: D9's operating variable is the inter-trade interval and the lineage deliberately estimates no intensity, so n_eff does NOT bind D9's construction on its own terms. Nothing here says a committed sub-burst is wrong. The load-bearing statement is the print count, which is read off the committed artifacts' own columns and needs no cross-method inference.
vs_subbursts.reading: The median committed sub-burst is 2-4 prints across all three lineages, with 46-71% of them at 3 prints or fewer. That is read off the artifacts' own n_prints column and requires nothing from this method. Cooper's phrasing -- 'a statement about the two or three fastest prints in a session, not about a market state' -- is therefore not a hypothesis awaiting test; it is what the committed artifacts already say about themselves. The resolution-floor comparison adds that no event in the cohort resolves below 58 ms at its most favourable moment, which is 21x above 10d's median sub-burst duration and 5 orders of magnitude above v4's -- but that comparison is across methods and carries the caveat above, whereas the print count does not.

deviations_recorded.why: v3 tiles the D3 extended session, not the data support; the origin cannot be inferred from the prints. Defaults reproduce the prior behaviour exactly and a test asserts it.

deviations_recorded.what: intervals() differences in int64 and takes an explicit origin; seconds_since() requires one positionally
deviations_recorded.why: float64 seconds since the epoch have a 238 ns ULP against a 49 ns minimum gap. Measured on ALXO_2020-08-05_31.58: 4 of 899 strictly increasing timestamps went non-positive and the worst gap error was 447 ns against a 954 ns scale floor.

deviations_recorded.what: the RATE channel gained the same n_eff >= 8 floor as the interval channel (found by independent verification, V5)
deviations_recorded.why: it masked only on c0 > 0, so a window holding a fraction of a print returned |dL/dln s| ~ 14 against 0.4-1.1 where there is real data -- and those values then set the colour scale. Masked share on the coarse band moved 0.24 -> 0.52 for AEHL once fixed.
recorded NEGATIVE result. Extremum decimation raises the background floor as much as the signal (p99 0.59 -> 1.53); the apparent win was an artefact of the unfloored rate channel above.

deviations_recorded.what: fine band charted over +/- 15 s inside a +/- 15 min read, not +/- 15 min as the brief states
deviations_recorded.why: a heatmap column cannot be narrower than its kernel; at +/- 15 min a chart-width grid gives 1.3 s per column against a 15.6 ms smallest kernel and the panel aliases. Compute cost unchanged.

deviations_recorded.what: segment assignment uses common.session_window, not the DuckDB ICU extension named in the adapter stub
deviations_recorded.why: the constraint is the ET wall clock, and it is met exactly. The tick path never opens DuckDB because the pass budget over filtered_trades is zero.
